synthesis.paragraph: Three of today's papers carry the tag "Transportation Planning and Optimization," focusing on examining dual exposure to traffic congestion and in-vehicle crowding, a predictive-prescriptive analytics framework for route planning, and a bibliometric and literature review of bus lane research. Outside of this group, one paper compares four data reduction methods to construct built environment typologies and analyze their associations with children's spatial behavior. Another paper introduces a CityGML extension for the 3D modeling of pedestrian mobility spaces. Finally, a third independent study presents a diagnostic assessment of Porto and Cagliari to align transit provision with urban morphology.
